tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description: List workflows on a self-hosted n8n instance.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the n8n instance, e.g. https://n8n.mydomain.com

tools.name: trigger_webhook
tools.description: Trigger an n8n workflow by POSTing a JSON payload to its Webhook node URL. What actually happens next is whatever the workflow itself does — this connector has no visibility into it.

webhookUrl.description: Full URL of the workflow's Webhook node trigger
